info.title: Psilocybin Research public read-only API
info.description: Anonymous public GET endpoints plus read-only MCP JSON-RPC POST for source-labeled bibliographic and trial metadata. No subscription, messaging, curation or private-source operations. Source abstracts and full texts are excluded. Read-only GET access needs no key. Use an identifiable client User-Agent; generic library user-agents may be rejected by the host.

get.summary: Download the complete public catalogue as compact JSON or titles-and-years TXT
get.description: No pagination or filtering. All visible psilocybin/psilocin publications, preprints and trial registrations, including missing years. Uses one database snapshot. Check complete and record_count == total_records == records.length. Explicit error above 50000 records; never a silently truncated success. TXT contains one YEAR — TITLE line per record, with n.d. for missing years. Response SHA-256 describes uncompressed UTF-8 body bytes. This is a complete directory of records with a compact field set, not all database fields. Use /database.php for public SQL metadata or /export.php?format=json&limit=50000 for broader public record objects.

200.description: Complete public catalogue; current count and retrieval time are returned, not fixed in documentation.

X-Publication-Tracker-Total.description: Total visible catalogue records in this database snapshot

X-Publication-Tracker-SHA256.description: SHA-256 of uncompressed response body bytes

400.description: Unsupported format or query filters; use the paginated papers API for searches.

413.description: Catalogue exceeds 50000 records; use the full public SQLite download.

503.description: Complete snapshot temporarily unavailable; respect Retry-After.

get.summary: Download the complete sanitized public SQLite database
get.description: Local SQL and full public bibliographic metadata with provenance and rights fields. Contains publications and metadata tables. Excludes private runtime data, raw importer payloads, source-derived abstracts and full texts. Save and inspect the database metadata for reproducibility. Does not accept the catalogue format or pagination parameters. This dynamic HEAD route does not generate a file or advertise its size. For verified exact sizes/checksums and inexpensive HEAD requests, use the SQLite artifact URL from /dataset-manifest.json.

200.description: Public SQLite database download. HEAD probes do not generate the database.

get.summary: Get complete public year/status counts and explicit unknown-year counts
get.description: Uses the same visible-record aggregate as the research trends table. No filters/pagination. All year totals plus missing-year records must equal record_count. Published is a site-normalized status, not an independent peer-review assessment. CSV adds one blank-year missing_year row. Match catalogue_revision when comparing to a frozen snapshot.

200.description: Reconciled counts for all public records, including missing years.

get.summary: Get authoritative byte sizes, SHA-256 checksums and URLs of completed public downloads
get.description: No visitor-triggered building. Atomic CLI publication retains the previous completed snapshot on failure. Check is_current before calling this the latest live data. Follow exact artifact URLs for checksum verification; do not substitute dynamic export routes. Latest three completed snapshots retained; preserve actual files for reproducibility.

200.description: Completed public dataset snapshot with exact artifacts.

is_current.description: Whether this completed snapshot still matches the live catalogue and export builders.

manifest_url.description: Versioned frozen manifest, without the live is_current field.

bytes.description: Exact downloaded file bytes after HTTP transfer decoding; compressed XZ/RDS files are hashed before decompression.

503.description: No completed snapshot available yet; live exports remain available. Respect Retry-After.

get.summary: Retrieve exact existing file bytes for a published snapshot
get.description: Use the URLs in dataset-manifest.json. GET serves the exact completed file; HEAD gives its real size and SHA-256 without rebuilding. SHA-256 and byte counts describe the downloaded file bytes after HTTP transfer decoding. For XZ/RDS, verify the compressed file before opening it. SQLite-XZ additionally records the underlying SQLite size/hash; RDS contains publications and metadata data frames from that SQLite. A retired/missing snapshot returns 404; no replacement snapshot is silently substituted. The manifest format returns the frozen manifest without the current endpoint’s is_current field.

200.description: Exact published file with Content-Length, X-Publication-Tracker-SHA256, X-Publication-Tracker-Snapshot and represented-record count.

404.description: Snapshot unavailable or retired; request latest manifest.

post.description: MCP JSON-RPC transport, not a REST search route. Initialize, notify initialized, list/call tools, list/read resources and ping. Eight tools expose existing public metadata only. No sessions, subscriptions, writes, arbitrary outbound URLs or publisher full texts. See /for-ai.html#connect-using-mcp and discover actual tool input/output schemas with tools/list.

parameters.name: MCP-Protocol-Version
parameters.description: Negotiated protocol on post-initialize requests; absent header defaults to 2025-03-26.

200.description: One JSON-RPC result or protocol error; tool execution errors use result.isError.

400.description: Malformed JSON/RPC or unsupported protocol header.

406.description: Client does not accept JSON responses.

405.description: Use MCP POST; no standalone SSE stream or session deletion.

get.summary: Selected source-checked study families and report roles
get.description: Exact DOI/NCT identities, evidence URLs and check dates. Selected reviewed coverage only; missing links are unknown and members are not independent cohorts. Optional visible record id. Frozen relationships are available as manifest artifact study-links.

200.description: Reviewed family catalogue or memberships for a visible record
